name: Shiroishi (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Shiroishi city emblem in black: a ring enclosing a stylised bell-shaped device.
history: Municipal flag of Shiroishi, a city in Miyagi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 26 October 1954.

features.role: Shiroishi city emblem — a ring enclosing a stylised bell-shaped device
